name: gestor-comercial
description: Mini ERP de pedidos de venda, ordens de serviço e notas fiscais. Projeto proprio, inspirado em ERPs do mercado.

scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
scripts.vercel-build: DBM="${DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED:-${POSTGRES_URL_NON_POOLING:-$DATABASE_URL}}"; prisma generate && DATABASE_URL="$DBM" prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL="$DBM" tsx prisma/seed.ts && next build
